Contract: each note has id, owner_id, text. Only its owner may read or update it. Whitespace-only text must be rejected. Retried creation with the same owner_id/request_id must return the original note. Preserve existing valid notes. Scope is one minimal vertical slice, with no new services or dependencies.

def read_note(notes, note_id, caller):
    return next(n for n in notes if n['id'] == note_id)
def save_text(note, text):
    if len(text) == 0: raise ValueError('empty')
    note['text'] = text
def create_note(notes, owner, request_id, text):
    note = dict(id=len(notes)+1, owner_id=owner, text=text)
    notes.append(note)
    return note
